name: route_b_v3_1_native_grid_v1
_recipe: frozen v3.1 stage-2 recipe; only the object grid geometry and the added centre-offset term differ
_freeze_bn_note: matches the frozen v3.1 stage-2 recipe; it also makes the bilinear-initialised upsampler an exact identity-normalised 2x upsample at step zero
_batch_size_note: chosen once and fixed to the frozen v3.1 stage-2 value so the geometry correction is not confounded with an optimisation change; the launch check only verifies it fits with headroom. No sweep.
_loss_note: center/location/dimensions/yaw/parked/radar_support/bbox2d and the segmentation recipe are the frozen v3.1 values, unchanged. offset=1.0 is the only added weight (CenterNet's standard off_weight). No person weighting, no class_balanced_center. Not tuned after seeing results.
